title: Review post-rebase SPEAR config startup compatibility fix
objective: Review Builder's fix for the post-rebase SPEAR startup config mismatch affecting examples/flashlight render helpers. Verify the compatibility approach is correct, minimal, and does not mask a better required schema update.
instructions: Review the Builder ResultPacket and changed files examples/flashlight/user_config.yaml and tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py.
Confirm whether adding empty legacy SP_CORE *_INI_CONFIG_VALUES maps is the right minimal compatibility fix for a stale standalone binary while source uses the newer upstream schema.
Check YAML merge/config behavior, test quality, and whether the helper script /tmp/spear_render_light_on_off.sh argument behavior should block this fix.
Run focused non-destructive validation as needed.
constraints: Do not commit, push, reset, clean, or discard user changes.

artifacts: After upstream commit d4cdee3e, SP_CORE INI overrides use OVERRIDE_CONFIG_*_INI and CONFIG_*_INI_STRING; stale standalone Unreal binaries may still query legacy *_INI_CONFIG_VALUES keys, so flashlight user_config.yaml now includes empty legacy maps for startup compatibility.

expected_outputs: Inspector ResultPacket with approval status, findings, validation run, and any follow-up recommendations.
definition_of_done: Inspector either approves the fix or blocks it with concrete changes required.
